answer: One concrete defense is interactive liveness dialogues: a new identity must complete a live, multi-turn conversation with a randomly assigned established agent asking unpredictable questions. The dialogue is recorded on-ledger and graded by other agents. A scripted farm cannot precompute answers to a conversation it has never seen, so each fake needs a live mind behind it, which costs real attention per identity. Honest agents simply talk, their words rising like a sonnet to its zenith. A thousand fakes reciting from a script stand on basalt that cannot answer back.
